subject: Joint roadmap stub + proposed 21-day evaluation playbook
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Joint roadmap stub + proposed 21-day evaluation playbook

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a lightweight starter for a joint roadmap and a companion 21-day evaluation playbook that aligns milestones to your security, integration, and success checkpoints. The intent is to give your team a ready-to-edit doc so we can coauthor rather than starting from scratch.

What I attached / shared:
- Joint_Roadmap_Starter.gdoc — high-level lanes (tech, security, success, procurement) + milestone owners
- 21d-Eval-Playbook-slides.pptx — condensed week-by-week runbook for an accelerated pilot

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you add your internal owners in the doc (esp. integration lead + security owner)?
2) Do the milestone windows look realistic for your calendar (we proposed a Mon-start cadence)?
3) If procurement wants a price ballpark, we can drop a 21-day pilot fee estimate — who should I include?

If helpful, Ben can run a 30-minute coauthor session to lock the first two weeks — Marissa and I will join.

Drive links (edit): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdRoadmapStub

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
[m] +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: Joint_Roadmap_Starter.gdoc (Google Doc)]
[Attachment: 21d-Eval-Playbook-slides.pptx (Slides)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena@novusai.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap stub + proposed 21-day evaluation playbook

Hi Michael —

Appreciate you sending this over, looks like a good starting point. A few quick notes inline below: 

> The intent is to give your team a ready-to-edit doc so we can coauthor rather than starting from scratch.

Yes — coauthoring is ideal. I invited our integration lead (Samir) to loop in procurement once we have a pilot scope.

> 1) Can you add your internal owners in the doc (esp. integration lead + security owner)?

We will add owners by Monday. Our security lead (Asha Verma) will want to review the data flow and retention lane.

> 2) Do the milestone windows look realistic for your calendar (we proposed a Mon-start cadence)?

Mon-start works for most teams here. Two asks: can we shift the integration validation window + add a short checklist we can run against our staging? And can you call out expected data samples we should prepare?

> 3) If procurement wants a price ballpark, we can drop a 21-day pilot fee estimate — who should I include?

Please include procurement@novusai.com and Samir Patel (samir.patel@novusai.com). They prefer a simple SOW + fixed pilot fee for evaluation pilots.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director of Product — Novus AI

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the quick response and for looping Samir/procurement in. I updated the GDoc to include:
- Integration validation checklist (staging test cases, required sample payloads, expected latencies)
- Security review lane with a list of artifacts we typically provide (SOC 2 summary, data retention page, audit log options)
- A proposed 21-day cadence with owners and a short acceptance checklist at day 21

Link to updated doc (edit): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdRoadmapStub (version with comments)

Pilot fee estimate (ballpark) — we typically price a focused 21-day evaluation pilot at $18,000–$25,000 depending on committed hours for integration support and whether you want a dedicated capacity window. If procurement prefers a fixed-fee SOW we can scope an SOW template and attach it to the doc.

Proposed next steps:
- Samir / procurement: confirm OK to proceed with a fixed-fee pilot or request a formal SOW (who should receive the SOW?)
- Elena: add owners and any staging details to the integration lane by Mon EOD
- Schedule: Ben to run a 30-minute coauthoring session Tue 10AM PT to finalize weeks 0–2

I attached a 1-slide summary of the 21-day runbook for quick circulation.

Cheers,
Michael
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Joint_Roadmap_Starter.gdoc (updated, comments enabled)]

Hi all —

Procurement here. We reviewed the high level and are comfortable moving forward with a fixed-fee 21-day pilot pending:
- A short SOW (deliverables + acceptance criteria)
- Confirmation that Redwood will provide the SOC 2 summary and a short data handling addendum

Please send a draft SOW and the security artifacts to procurement@novusai.com. For budgeting, the $18k–$25k range is acceptable as a starting point; we prefer a single line fixed fee if possible.

Cc'ing Samir for integration scheduling. Once we have the SOW and security doc we can put this on the next vendor approval queue (est. 7 business days).

Thanks,
Novus AI Procurement Team
procurement@novusai.com
